rebar-debug Phase 1 classification — DESIGN ESCALATION / intended behavior (no production fix applied)

Proven mechanism: live run 32000764439 shows Jira DC returned HTTP 400 for RBJGHOST ("does not exist for the field project"), then src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/fetcher.py:539-577 caught that non-truncation transport error because multiple projects were mapped, emitted fetcher-project-fetch-failed, and logged "SKIPPING it ... continuing the pass". Thus Jira did not silently change its response; current rebar control flow deliberately isolated the failed project.

Discriminating proof: focused non-external test tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_fetch_multi_project.py::test_one_project_base_query_failure_does_not_abort_pass passes on current main and asserts exactly alert + isolation + continued valid-project results. Git history shows the live test contract predates the behavior change: 80b8189f30 (2026-08-14) added whole-pass fail-closed expectation, while 419d0c7784 (2026-08-15), closed/verified task arrogant-screaming-zethuswasp (a01d-b024-49dd-4254), deliberately superseded it for multi-project passes and explicitly names unknown-project HTTP 400 among isolated failures. Later 9eb8c34df5 / archetypal-curvy-piranha intentionally applies mapped-project visibility preflight only to mutating Jira Cloud passes; previews and jira-datacenter skip it.

defect_legitimacy: intended-behavior. The failing live expectation is stale under the newer explicit contract. No RED/GREEN production repair is authorized by the not-a-bug guard.

Recommended grouped decision: (A) update the Jira DC live scenario to assert alerting, no partial unknown-project data, and continuation of valid projects (recommended, aligns with a01d), or (B) adopt a new product contract for DC mutating passes via a separate Jira DC visibility-preflight story, revisiting the explicit a011 non-Cloud skip. Preview behavior is independently a choice because current preflight intentionally excludes read-only passes. This ticket is parked for the requested batch of not-a-bug/design decisions.
